diagrams.title: Before: one authority, uncertain failures
diagrams.description: Security and durable execution exist; replication/failover and freshness-aware recovery are not yet specified.

diagrams.title: After: consistent writes and eligible reads
diagrams.description: Result and outbox intent commit locally. Duplicate-safe projection records a contiguous watermark. Current policy never uses stale fallback.

diagrams.title: Commit-to-recovery sequence
diagrams.description: Verify authority, commit, acknowledge, deliver, read and recover. A lost acknowledgement or lag does not authorise a new provider operation.

lab_title: Which read is safe within the budget?
lab_assumptions: Three controls isolate a read leg. Lag zero represents proven minimum-version coverage, not actual clock-based freshness. Primary is assumed reachable; protected disclosure still needs current security/audit gates.
